steps.text: Turn on “Offload Unused Apps”. iOS will remove apps you rarely use but keep their documents and data.
Reinstalling an offloaded app from the App Store restores it exactly where you left off.
Wait for the list to load, then tap a large app you rarely open.
Tap “Offload App”. The app icon stays on your Home Screen with a cloud symbol; its data is kept.
Swipe left on videos and images you no longer need, or tap Edit to delete several at once.
This signs you out of most websites — keep passwords handy before confirming.
Open the Photos app and scroll to Utilities (iOS 18) or Albums → Recently Deleted.
Photos you delete keep using space here for up to 30 days.
Tap Select → Delete All to reclaim the space immediately. Only do this after OffloadPro has verified your copies!
Settings → Photos → “Optimize iPhone Storage” keeps only small thumbnails on your phone; originals live in iCloud.
That means your originals are rented: stop paying for iCloud and you can lose access to full-quality photos.
OffloadPro always downloads the original before offloading, verifies the copy, and only then offers deletion — so the storage you own has the real files.
